notice: Development profile. Route presence is not semantic parity. Source hashes include local reference changes. No deployment is performed.

systems.Name: AIGym
systems.Purpose: Local extension: nearest-neighbour model training and inference
Limitations: Local extension, not an upstream mandatory Arrowhead 5.2.2 support system. Native k-nearest-neighbour behavior and persisted samples are implemented; all Java observation publishing semantics are not ported.

systems.Name: Blacklist
Limitations: Time-bounded active/revoked records persist in JSON. Complete Java normalization, historical reactivation and query mode edge cases need golden-contract tests.

systems.Name: CertificateAuthority
systems.Purpose: Profile-constrained CSR issuance, revocation and trusted keys
Limitations: CSR and CRL operations use a separately provisioned CA key; no CA key is generated/copied by this port. CRL export does not prove enforcement by every relying party. Java SQL import, automatic CRL file publication, HSM/OCSP/HA are absent.
The source reference uses a shared non-Spring HTTP dispatcher. Its route coverage is not inferred from Go route presence; manual JavaSupportRuntime review is required.

systems.Name: Choreographer
systems.Purpose: Plan, executor and dependency-ordered session management
Limitations: Local synchronous orchestration and executor start/callback flow are implemented. Async orchestration callbacks return 501. Java executor dependency negotiation, optimal selection, session notifications and remote abort propagation are incomplete.

systems.Name: Configuration
Limitations: JSON persistence replaces JPA/SQL. Proxy currently serves the local configuration store instead of Java external-provider fallback.

systems.Name: DataManager
systems.Purpose: SenML historian and authorized provider data proxy
Limitations: Historian packs are persisted locally. Proxy resolves registered HTTPS get-data/put-data operations and uses its own identity. Complete SenML normalization, signalCount semantics, Java provider-configuration and MQTT ingestion are not ported.

systems.Name: DeviceQoSEvaluator
Limitations: Uses explicit DeviceMeasurementAgent input. The complete Java SNMP/OID discovery, augmentation and scaling engine is not ported; scores are weighted window means with missing-data rejection.

systems.Name: EventHandler
Limitations: HTTPS callbacks use a persistent bounded outbox and at most three attempts. MQTT notifications, complete Java executor/backoff settings and distributed exactly-once guarantees are absent.

systems.Name: GateTunnel
systems.Purpose: Authorized legacy-mTLS relay and tunnel sessions
Limitations: Legacy-mTLS relay sessions are supported; control-session records are not a second AMQP tunnel data plane. AH-GT-1 encrypted requests are rejected. Consumer listeners are volatile and renegotiated after restart.
The source reference uses a shared non-Spring HTTP dispatcher. Its route coverage is not inferred from Go route presence; manual JavaSupportRuntime review is required.

systems.Name: Gatekeeper
Limitations: Reuses the existing native Go legacy-mTLS relay engine, adapted to pinned clients. AH-GT-1 end-to-end encryption is absent. Broker ACLs and trusted neighbour provisioning remain required; no live federation is exercised by this delivery.
The source reference uses a shared non-Spring HTTP dispatcher. Its route coverage is not inferred from Go route presence; manual JavaSupportRuntime review is required.

systems.Name: Onboarding
systems.Purpose: Controlled certificate, device and system onboarding
Limitations: Enrollment records use JSON, not the Java database. System/identity/registry operations form a partial compensating saga, not a distributed transaction. Complete renewal, crash recovery, withdrawal of approved systems and prerequisite-service discovery require further work.

systems.Name: PlantDescriptionEngine
systems.Purpose: Plant topology and monitored alarm state
Limitations: Topology/include composition, named and metadata matching, periodic alarms, and atomic PDE-to-DSO snapshot synchronization are implemented. Missing producers retain managed empty scopes; nonnegative priorities rank eligible providers. Java SQL import, complete DTO normalization and production qualification remain outside this extension.

systems.Name: SysMonitor
systems.Purpose: Monitoring subscriptions, history and durable observation forwarding
Limitations: AMQPS intake and MQTT QoS1 outbox forwarding are implemented. MQTT uses Paho 3.1.1 rather than Java MQTTv5. Full live-broker/UI parity and imported Java history have not been certified. The default subscription is none until configured.
The source reference uses a shared non-Spring HTTP dispatcher. Its route coverage is not inferred from Go route presence; manual JavaSupportRuntime review is required.

systems.Name: TimeManager
Limitations: SNTP checks report offset/trust without changing the host clock. Full Java time-source caching, source-selection and trust policy are not ported.

systems.Name: TranslationManager
Limitations: Port of the Java TranslatorBridgeEngine (2026-10-24): interface translators (interfaceBridgeManagement) and data model translators (dataModelTranslation, or dataModelTranslatorFactoryControl factories) are discovered in the ServiceRegistry by their metadata; check-targets, initialize-bridge and abort-bridge follow the Java driver contracts; bridge statuses, transitions, reports and the 8-hour discovery cleanup are the Java ones.

Translators are called over mutual TLS with the identity token; translators whose interfaceBridgeManagement interface uses a TOKEN_AUTH policy are not selected, and custom translator configuration (a TODO in the Java reference) is not sent.
Default matchmaking takes the first acceptable translator; the Java matchmaker beans are not pluggable.
